item.description: City officials told WANE 15 they are aware of the issue, though it is unclear of what the issue actually is. Crews are working to locate and resolve the problem.

item.title: Punxsutawney Phil sees his shadow, 6 more weeks of winter
item.description: It's already been a long, cold winter across much of the United States, and on Monday, Punxsutawney Phil's handlers will announce whether the weather-predicting groundhog says there's more of the same to come.

item.title: Indiana House votes yes on casino bill
item.description: This afternoon, the state House of Representatives took a vote on House Bill 1038, a bill that would help move a casino to another part of Indiana.

item.title: 5 evacuate house fire in southeast Fort Wayne
item.description: Five people safely evacuated a burning home in the 4500 blk. of Lillie St. Monday night. Two cats did not survive.
